name: Clean Image for Google Merchant (WC)
author: merchantpure

sections.description:
Clean Image for Google Merchant (WC) lets you assign a dedicated, policy-compliant product image that is used only for Google Merchant Center and other feeds.

This is ideal when:
* Your storefront uses promotional images with badges, logos or text.
* Google Merchant requires a clean, neutral image without overlays.

The plugin adds a metabox inside the product edit screen with:
* A clean image selector (using the WordPress Media Library).
* A hidden attachment ID field.
* A clean image URL field.
* A simple fallback to the product featured image if no clean image is set.

The image URL is also registered in the REST API as post meta “_gm_image_url”, making it easy to integrate with any feed plugin (for example mapping it as image_link).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Edit any product and look for the “Google Merchant – Clean Image” metabox in the sidebar.
  5. Select or upload a clean product image (without text or logos) and save the product.

  • Translated the admin UI into English and prepared it for localization.

  • Added “Requires Plugins: woocommerce” header for dependency declaration.

  • Initial public release.
